title: TimePicker
description: Fiori time picker: a time field with the clock-dial time selection (hours, minutes, seconds, AM/PM).

usage.summary: Enter or select a localized time without a date.
useWhen: Let users choose a time of day when the date is irrelevant or supplied separately.
Allow direct typing as well as choosing hours, minutes and seconds in the picker.
Set formatPattern to the required precision and 12-hour or 24-hour convention.

avoidWhen.when: Enter both a date and a time together.
Enter plain text without date or time parsing, or compose a custom picker with caller-owned value rules.
